BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

Replacement fittings: check before you buy

A new sink, tap or toilet is not always a direct swap. Dimensions, fixing positions, connections and waste routes can differ. A photo of the current fitting and a link to the replacement can make the initial discussion more useful and help avoid ordering something unsuitable.

  • Measure the available space.
  • Share the model or product link if you have chosen a fitting.
  • Mention restricted access to connections.
